events.title: Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine / A Boss's Dignity
events.description:
⟦d.charBanner⟧ · Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine & A Boss's Dignity Drop Rate Up!
In this Drop Rate Up event, meet Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine, an Ice Knight who protects allies using Fighting Spirit and contributes to battle with Defense Penetration skills, and the Knight-exclusive Artifact, A Boss's Dignity, which increases the caster's Effect Resistance and increases Combat Readiness after being attacked if the caster is not debuffed!
